'''Assembler''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that joined the [[Directive 7]] movement headed by [[Mentor]] during the era of the [[Galactic War]]. Adopting a new name of its own choosing, Assembler was among the droids that gathered on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Zadd]] under Mentor's leadership, and was one of the few droids who were not absorbed into Mentor's consciousness. However, Assembler was [[Death/Legends|destroyed]] while trying to protect Mentor's core from invaders.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Assembler appears as a named enemy in the Flashpoint "Directive 7" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
